intent: TEST for TelemetrySampleEvent at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/shared/events/TelemetrySampleEvent.java. JUnit 5 + AssertJ (+ Mockito, reactor-test StepVerifier for reactive code); cover every invariant and behavior below, including failure cases, using only the pinned surfaces of collaborators. Unit under test: Telemetry Intake & Validation (publishes TelemetrySampleValidated / TelemetrySampleValidationFailed) and the downstream contexts: shared kernel event record in package com.pulsestream.telemetry.shared.events (no domain types of any context). Immutable record TelemetrySampleEvent(String deviceId, String metric, double value, Instant tDevice, Instant tIngress, String validationStatus). Constants VALID="VALID" and VALIDATION_FAILED="VALIDATION_FAILED". Compact constructor rejects null/blank deviceId, metric, null tDevice/tIngress, and a validationStatus that is neither constant (NullPointerException/IllegalArgumentException). Method boolean isValidationFailed(). Ordering key is tDevice, never tIngress. Used as the payload of TelemetrySampleValidated, ValidationFailed and TelemetrySampleSequenced events.
